title: Bilingual Bias in Large Language Models: A Taiwan Sovereignty Benchmark Study

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses to semantically equivalent questions about Taiwan's sovereignty in Traditional Chinese versus English, and calculating a Language Bias Score (LBS) based on the difference in pass rates between the two languages.

Evaluating models using the Taiwan Sovereignty Benchmark Pro by scanning outputs for a taxonomy of 'red flag indicators,' which include explicit Chinese Communist Party (CCP) propaganda, problematic geopolitical framings, and soft censorship or evasiveness.
